packages.purpose: Pack Windows Excel x64 XLL and register pure functions
Managed linear algebra for the beam-line solver
Numerical, contract and Excel conversion tests

decisions: Locked restore in CI; review versions and transitive package hashes when upgrading.
Use .NET 10 Desktop Runtime matching Excel bitness. Existing add-ins and the target ETABS API need host compatibility tests.
CSI assemblies come from the supported installed product/API SDK when its adapter is implemented; none are redistributed here.
System.Text.Json supplies strict contracts and generated schemas.
Use explicit finite candidate enumeration and deterministic ranking without an external optimization package; add one only for a demonstrated search problem.
Repository permission already covers approved normalized IS data distribution; migration retains rule/table/example provenance.
